method_identity: Unchanged community Coleman/Tiger Growth-style judgment framework; not recovered personal investor algorithm or actual view.

native_method_steps.original_text: Define product, customer, and growth engine.
native_method_steps.judgment: Scalable ad-supported platform within universe; AI contribution not separately established.
Positive aggregate operating economics, but falling FoA margin and missing advertiser cohort retention prevent high-confidence full underwriting.

native_method_steps.original_text: Estimate growth duration and competitive moat.
native_method_steps.judgment: Network-feedback moat is analyst inference; five-year growth conditional on cost discipline and competitiveness, not proof.

native_method_steps.original_text: Compare valuation to multi-year compounding path.
native_method_steps.report_section: Setup / Thesis 第四步 and A1
native_method_steps.judgment: Common worksheet reference return below chosen hurdle; unsupported parameter inflation not used.

method_cards.reason: Original Coleman Skill has no card-selection contract; no other master method imported.

filters.name: scalableModel
filters.basis: Large audience, ad monetization and positive segment profits.

filters.name: unitEconomicsPositiveOrImproving
filters.basis: Positive FoA operating margins; recent margin decline limits improvement claim. Marginal/customer economics unresolved.

filters.name: growthDurationCredible
filters.basis: Plausible platform compounding but no calibrated five-year profit trajectory.

filters.name: brokenRetention
filters.basis: No cohort retention data; absence of evidence is not proven retention.

filters.name: noPathToProfit
filters.basis: Material historical consolidated and FoA profits.

filters.name: riskDefined
filters.basis: Business invalidation and capital-intensity risks listed; no portfolio risk budget or sizing.

filters.name: evidenceSufficient
filters.basis: Missing customer cohorts and infrastructure return data constrain stronger verdict.

common_worksheet.role: Analyst comparability overlay, not native Coleman doctrine
common_worksheet.parameter_revision: No numerical revision sufficiently justified from base-only evidence.

gaps_and_source_limitations.note: Company FCF is a cash-flow measure after cash PPE and lease principal. It is not audited FCFF or Buffett owner earnings. Maintenance/growth capex split, sustainable tax rate, operating working-capital conventions, interest adjustments, future SBC/dilution treatment and discount rate are not supplied. Missing does not mean zero. This is no gate on useful qualitative analysis or a labeled scenario.
Use Sept 30 cash/debt observation plus separately dated November financing. Do not present Sept cash minus debt as Dec net cash; Q4 cash uses and cash generation are unknown here.

No SaaS subscription NDR, logo churn, CAC payback or customer-level LTV is invented. Advertiser retention/cohort data are not disclosed in this packet. DAP growth and ARPP are aggregate engagement/monetization, not retention.

2,572m Q3 weighted-average diluted shares are a scenario denominator, not actual shares outstanding. 2,520,527,597 Oct 24 actual A+B shares are an earlier capitalisation proxy. Do not combine A-only shares with group earnings.
This research was retrieved in 2026 from source-dated pre-cutoff documents. It does not claim preservation of a 2025 browse session. Later search results were screened out.
SBC is included in GAAP costs and added back in CFO. Method must separately choose and disclose dilution or economic-cost treatment, avoiding an automatic double penalty.
Cash finance-lease principal is included. Bond debt excludes lease liabilities. No claim of complete all-in enterprise value or complete economic net debt.
Ad improvements cannot be separated from demand/mix; no quantitative ROI or capex split supplied.
E0 is Q3-ended TTM with only designated disclosed adjustments; five-year compounding convention from cutoff does not create FY2025 earnings.
